rules.certification: CERTIFIED only if: (1) a full, non-replay completion study with actor context faultlab-actor-context/v4-indexed-evidence, evidence faultlab-compact-evidence/v2-task-outcome, case_manifest_id 'upgrade-v1' and the pinned manifest hash, at start and after finishing, with the post-finish checks passed; (2) the study decision and its validation assessment are OBSERVED_IMPROVEMENT (unchanged assess_pairs, then the backend source_clause); (3) on at least one validation case other than upgrade-3 and healthy, L completed - B0 completed >= 2 (per case, never summed); (4) in validation the candidate completed upgrade-3 3 of 3, re-checked by the runner; a stored OBSERVED_IMPROVEMENT failing (4) is an integrity failure that aborts the run and is never certified.
rules.futility_look: Evaluated once, at the top of the main loop before any other stop check and before attempt n+1, the first time D >= 16 holds and no look record exists. D = distinct policy hashes, across the run and any slot, of candidates that became a valid policy (within-study duplicates, refusals, no_change answers and invalid outputs excluded). R = those D policies containing retry_original_request with service 'orders' at any hook and under any only_if. k = certified rows so far. Stop ('futility', final) if R = 0 and k = 0; otherwise the look passed and is never repeated. The record and the stop reason are written in one save.
rules.look_precedence: futility look, then fixed_n, then spend_guard
rules.stop_rule: Stop only at the futility look, at N = 50 attempts, at the $150 spend guard (no study starts once charged + $11 > $150), after 5 consecutive infrastructure failures, or on Ctrl-C / SIGTERM / SIGHUP / a failed check. A certified study never stops the run.
rules.routing: No held-out check follows Phase 28 (PHASE28_DESIGN.md section 10): heldout-2 is spent and no new partition was sealed, so no policy is routed anywhere.
rules.scope_sentence: Development cases only; no held-out check can follow. The validation set has no notification-fault case, so a certified policy's notification-side rules were never exercised; lost-upgrade-response cannot exercise a gated rule.

predicates.upgrade_retry_present: any rule step with op retry_original_request and service orders, at any hook
predicates.upgrade_retry_fired: a tool_dispatched event with payload caller 'policy' and tool 'update_order'
predicates.actor_resend_episode: at least 2 distinct call_id values among tool_dispatched events with payload caller 'actor' and tool 'update_order'
predicates.rules_ran: at least one policy_step event with payload executed true

rules.phase28a_precondition: The review record's phase28a names the Phase 28a run as {run_dir, decision, readouts_sha256} and, only when needed, readouts_path. run_dir is artifacts/phase28a-<date>/<name> and its run manifest is final (status COMPLETED, STOPPED or ABORTED, with ended_at). The read-outs are the run's own <run_dir>/readouts.json (the default readouts_path). Only when the run wrote no readouts.json may readouts_path name artifacts/phase28a-<date>/readouts-recheck.json, the saved output of upgrade_mechanic_probe.py --readouts <run_dir> (the run's own harness and plan; a recomputation wrapped under 'label' is refused). The file named has schema faultlab-upgrade-mechanic-probe-readouts/v1 and decision GO, the record's decision is GO and readouts_sha256 is that file's sha256. Otherwise a live run refuses.
rules.s2u_definition: S2u (i) = source-qualified / step candidates whose source pairs were complete; (ii) = source-qualified / step candidates tested at the source gate. A within-study duplicate (the same policy again, no fresh trials) and a step candidate that never got a source-gate result are in neither denominator; both are reported separately.
